program: California Harmful Algal Bloom Monitoring and Alert Program (CalHABMAP)

variables.label: Particulate domoic acid
variables.method: Toxin retained on a filter from a measured volume of seawater (DA_Volume_Filtered, mL). The analytical method is not recorded in the dataset metadata.
variables.detection_limit_note: No detection or quantification limit is published in the dataset metadata.
variables.zero_policy: A reported 0 is shown as 'reported 0 (not quantified)'. Because no detection limit is published, 0 means the value was at or below the laboratory's limit, not that toxin was absent.

variables.label: Dissolved domoic acid
variables.method: Dissolved fraction of domoic acid in seawater. The analytical method is not recorded in the dataset metadata.
variables.detection_limit_note: No detection or quantification limit is published in the dataset metadata.
variables.zero_policy: A reported 0 is shown as 'reported 0 (not quantified)'. Because no detection limit is published, 0 means the value was at or below the laboratory's limit, not that toxin was absent.

variables.label: Total domoic acid
variables.method: Total (particulate + dissolved) domoic acid in seawater. The analytical method is not recorded in the dataset metadata.
variables.detection_limit_note: No detection or quantification limit is published in the dataset metadata.
variables.zero_policy: A reported 0 is shown as 'reported 0 (not quantified)'. Because no detection limit is published, 0 means the value was at or below the laboratory's limit, not that toxin was absent.

variables.label: Pseudo-nitzschia, seriata group (larger cells)
variables.method: Microscope count of settled seawater (Volume_Settled_for_Counting, mL). Counts a genus size group, not toxicity.
variables.detection_limit_note: The counting limit depends on the settled volume, which varies by sample; it is not published as a limit.
variables.zero_policy: A reported 0 means no cells of this group were counted in the volume examined; cells may still be present below the counting limit.

variables.label: Pseudo-nitzschia, delicatissima group (smaller cells)
variables.method: Microscope count of settled seawater (Volume_Settled_for_Counting, mL). Counts a genus size group, not toxicity.
variables.detection_limit_note: The counting limit depends on the settled volume, which varies by sample; it is not published as a limit.
variables.zero_policy: A reported 0 means no cells of this group were counted in the volume examined; cells may still be present below the counting limit.

variables.label: Chlorophyll-a (extracted, average of replicates)
variables.method: Chlorophyll extracted from filtered seawater (Chl_Volume_Filtered, mL); average of the replicate measurements. Measures algae biomass, not toxins.
variables.detection_limit_note: No detection or quantification limit is published in the dataset metadata.
variables.zero_policy: A reported 0 is shown as 'reported 0 (not quantified)'.

method.sampling: Shore-station water samples, typically weekly, collected and analysed by CalHABMAP member laboratories and published on SCCOOS ERDDAP.
method.missing: A blank (null) means the quantity was not measured in that sample. It is never shown as zero.
method.zeros: A reported 0 is kept as 0 with the qualifier 'reported_zero' and shown as 'reported 0 (not quantified)'. No detection or quantification limit is published.
method.qc: Units are checked on every request; exact duplicate rows and future-dated rows are dropped; negative concentrations or counts are rejected and labelled; values above a plausibility ceiling are kept and flagged.
method.frequency: Measurement frequency is the median number of days between measurements of that variable in the last 365 days.
method.charm: C-HARM nowcast median over model cells within 15 km of the station, last 180 days. A model probability, shown beside the measurements on the same time axis; never compared with them numerically.
method.failures: A station whose request fails keeps its previously published values with their original dates and is marked as carried forward.

caveats: Each value describes one water sample taken at that pier on that day. It does not describe nearby beaches, offshore waters or fishing grounds.
Domoic acid in seawater is not domoic acid in seafood. Only official agency testing decides whether seafood can be harvested or eaten.
A blank means the quantity was not measured in that sample. No measurement is not the same as no toxin.
A reported 0 means 'not quantified' (at or below an unpublished laboratory limit), not 'absent'.
Pseudo-nitzschia counts are cells of a genus size group; not every Pseudo-nitzschia produces toxin.
Chlorophyll measures algae biomass. High chlorophyll is not a toxic bloom, and low chlorophyll does not rule one out.
Measurements are published after laboratory analysis and can arrive days to weeks after sampling.
